intents.answer: Fee schedules vary by project scope, but here are some prototype sample estimates: Business Tax Certificate (~$200/year), Zoning Review (~$400), Building Permit (varies widely based on valuation), Sign Permit (~$350). *Please note these are prototype sample fees and not official City rates.*

You can contact City departments for official guidance. Finance Department: (408) 535-7055. Planning Division: (408) 535-3555. Building Division: (408) 535-3555. Environmental Health: (408) 918-3400. Fire Prevention: (408) 535-7750.

Zoning Clearance ensures your business type is allowed at your chosen location. You should check with the Planning Division before signing a lease. You'll need the site address and your proposed use and hours.

If your business involves cooking or a commercial kitchen, you will likely need a grease trap (Grease Interceptor). This requires review by Environmental Health and the Building Division to ensure it meets health and plumbing safety standards.

Sign Permits are required for new exterior signs, illuminated signs, or awnings. The Planning Division reviews the sign's size, design, and placement. You will need to provide dimensions, materials, and a photo of the storefront.

Building Permits are required for structural changes, plumbing, electrical work, or HVAC upgrades. The Building Division reviews your plans to ensure safety. You will need to submit a scope of work, drawings, and contractor information.
Most new businesses must register and obtain a Business Tax Certificate from the Finance Department. You'll need your business name, ownership details, and state registration confirmation.

Health and Safety Permits are required for food service and commercial kitchens. The Environmental Health department and Fire Prevention office will review your floor plan, equipment list, and menu to ensure safe food handling and fire safety.
Required documents vary by permit, but generally include: business ownership details, site address, scope of work, proposed use, drawn plans or sketches, and contractor information if applicable.
